استضفتن (form X)
# اِسْتَضَفْتُنَّ (istaḍaftunna) /is.ta.dˤaf.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَضَافَ (istaḍāfa)
# اُسْتُضِفْتُنَّ (ustuḍiftunna) /us.tu.dˤif.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَضَافَ (istaḍāfa)
